questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: Present perfect for life experience: have + never + past participle.

wrongReasons.was never: Experience up to now uses the present perfect: have never been.

questions.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress when another action interrupted.

wrongReasons.walked: 'walked' does not show that the action was in progress.

questions.text: While I ___ (walk) home, it started to rain.
